summary: Second backend testing run. Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 21 to 41 tests, adding coverage for: bank transfer flow (initiate + submit + admin approve + idempotency + admin-only guard), EOI end-to-end (talent creates open EOI -> employer sees -> accepts -> engagement created -> re-accept blocked -> insufficient-hours 400), availability + calendar events, all required integration providers (jira/asana/confluence/monday/sap/servicenow/ms_dynamics/wrike), MS-Project XML upload + unsupported-extension rejection, connected accounts role filtering + connect/upsert/disconnect + token-strip + unknown-provider guard, and /api/pricing 3-plan payload. Also updated stale iteration-1 assertions (/api/packages now returns {packages,bank,usd_to_inr}; insufficient-hours test now resets balance to avoid ordering coupling). Ran with pytest -n0 for deterministic order — all 41/41 passing against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

minor.issue: Employer can submit a UTR for a payment that is already approved/paid — no state guard beyond method check. Consider rejecting if status is already 'completed' or 'rejected'.
Returns {ok:true} even when payment_id does not exist (silent no-op). Should 404 like /approve does for consistency.
GET filter for employers uses {employer_id: None} which matches open EOIs to any employer. Works, but there is no way for an employer to filter only EOIs targeted at them vs open. Add a query param.
Any authenticated user can read any other user's availability. Fine for talent-browsing but consider restricting employer availability to admins.

action_items: Consider adding state guard on /api/payments/bank/submit to reject submissions on already-completed/rejected payments.
/api/admin/bank-transfers/{id}/reject should 404 when payment_id is unknown (currently silent success).
server.py is 945 lines — split into routers (auth/payments/engagements/eoi/integrations/accounts).
Add rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook expects 5-fail lockout).
CORS_ORIGINS still defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — enforce explicit origins in prod.
Encrypt at rest tokens stored in integration_tokens and connected_accounts.api_token (currently plaintext).
critical_code_review_comments: Bank flow correctly credits +hours on admin approve and is idempotent (already:true on 2nd approve).
EOI accept properly enforces employer role + hours balance + creates engagement + marks EOI accepted with engagement_id.
Connected accounts endpoint correctly strips api_token from responses and enforces role via provider.for list.
Work upload correctly rejects .mpp with a helpful message and returns 400 on unsupported extensions.
MS Project XML parser works but namespace-scoped ElementTree find may miss tasks depending on export style — tolerated in test.
/api/talent listing returns full profile including hourly_rate publicly; documented as intentional.
Availability read exposes name/role/timezone of any user id — consider restricting.
/api/admin/bank-transfers/{id}/reject does not verify payment exists before update — silent no-op.

seed_data_creation: Each run creates: 1 talent user, 1 employer user, ~2 EOIs, ~2 engagements (signing test + EOI-accept), 1 approved bank_transfer payment_transaction (INR 116200 -> +50 hours credited), 1 initiated Stripe checkout session, 1 asana stub integration + a few work_items, and .xlsx + .xml uploaded work_items. Employer hours_balance manipulated via pymongo direct DB writes (skipped if MONGO_URL not exported).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (41 tests, all passing). Run with `set -a && . /app/backend/.env && set +a && pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -n0` — the -n0 flag disables xdist parallel scheduling to keep intra-fixture DB seeding deterministic (a few tests share the module-scoped employer_sess and mutate hours_balance directly). Admin login used for bank-transfer approve tests. Stripe checkout returns a real sandbox session URL (not followed). Iteration 1's stray decorator on startup() has been fixed by main agent.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues found. Only pre-existing iteration-1 test assertion needed updating because /api/packages contract changed to be wrapped in {packages, bank, usd_to_inr}; and an xdist ordering coupling in the insufficient-hours test was resolved by explicitly zeroing hours_balance.
